findings.detail: The trainer loads one precomputed sentence_t5.npy vector per item and trains on those deterministic vectors. It never loads item metadata text, creates independently corrupted views, computes view means/variances, or quantizes multiple views. The uncertainty_agreement helper is not imported or called anywhere in the trainer. Thus the implemented training objective remains the baseline RQ-VAE objective, not the proposed uncertainty-aware tokenizer.
findings.reproduction: Inspect main(): embeddings is loaded once at line 229, then selected into train_embeddings at lines 235-236 and passed as a single batch input in the loop at lines 299-304. Repository search finds the helper only in uncertainty.py and no trainer call site.
findings.correction: Build M independent metadata-dropout views only for training-split items, encode each, train the reconstruction/commitment objective on the view mean against the baseline target, and include the weighted per-item SID disagreement term. Export by quantizing the mean of M views as specified.

findings.detail: The proposed agreement penalty is completely non-differentiable: token inequality produces boolean comparisons cast to float, and variance is explicitly detached. The returned scalar has no gradient path to encoder, quantizer, or codebook parameters. Even if added to the trainer, it cannot optimize code stability; the docstring assertion that gradients flow through a paired reconstruction objective does not make gradients flow through this term. The existing baseline loss may backpropagate, but no backward can train from this intended regularizer.
findings.reproduction: For any encoded_views with requires_grad=True and integer token_views, compute p=uncertainty_agreement(encoded_views, token_views); p.requires_grad is False, and p.backward() raises RuntimeError: element 0 of tensors does not require grad.
findings.correction: Use a differentiable agreement surrogate (for example, pairwise soft assignment/code probability disagreement) with gradients to the encoder and/or quantizer, or explicitly define a straight-through estimator consistent with the objective. Add a focused forward/backward check asserting finite, nonzero gradients reach the intended parameters and verify the agreement term changes those parameters.
